title: Chabi
wikitext:
{{Infobox Character |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Chabi Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Chabi Model.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |title= |alias= |race= [[Hylian]] |gender= Female{{Cite|You ran into Chabi, who likes to make new weapons using all sorts of different materials, at East Akkala Stable. She's determined to make the strongest weapon in the world.

She believes a {{Color TotK|Red|weapon made with a Lynel horn}} would earn the title. Apparently there's a Lynel near the entrance to Tempest Gulch.|Adventure Log|TotK}} |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |family= |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Chabi||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Chabi|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|Chabi|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Chabi is a [[Hylian]] traveler who can be found throughout [[Hyrule]]. She carries a [[Hunter's Shield]] and a [[Traveler's Sword]]. [[Link]] can save her from [[Bokoblin]]s that regularly attack her as she camps. She always gives [[Monster Extract]] as a reward.{{Cite|It's called monster extract. A guy named {{Color BotW|Red|Kilton}} brews this stuff up at {{Color BotW|Red|Fang and Bone}}.|Chabi|BotW}} The first time Link saves her, Chabi asks him how much he knows about [[Kilton]] and the [[Fang and Bone]].{{Cite|You seem to get around. You know much about {{Color BotW|Red|Kilton}} and his {{Color BotW|Red|Fang and Bone}}?|Chabi|BotW}} She gives Link a Monster Extract and explains that it was made by Kilton. It makes [[Food]] taste better, and despite being made of monsters, Chabi considers it to be good.{{Cite|It's a kind of flavoring that makes any food taste amazing. I know it's made of monsters, but it's good stuff.|Chabi|BotW}} She also shares rumors about Kilton, such as the fact that he is obsessed with monsters and does research with them.{{Cite|There are some weird stories going around about that Kilton characters. He's obsessed with monsters. They say he does all kinds of hair-raising research with them and came up with a bunch of strange stuff as a result.|Chabi|BotW}} Chabi wants to meet Kilton to see if the stories are true, but he is difficult to track down.{{Cite|I kind of want to meet him at least once to see if the rumors are true, but he's a hard guy to track down.|Chabi|BotW}}{{Cite|I'd kind of like to meet him just to see what kind of weirdo loves monsters THAT much.|Chabi|BotW}} She has heard from a trusted source that he is often found at a [[Skull Lake|skull-shaped lake]] in [[Akkala]].{{Cite|One source I trust says he's most often found at a {{Color BotW|Blue|skull-shaped lake}} in Akkala, but I don't know the place.|Chabi|BotW}}{{Cite|The most reliable tip I've heard for meeting him is to hang around a {{Color BotW|Blue|skull-shaped lake}} out near Akkala.|Chabi|BotW}} According to her, Kilton is more interested in researching monsters than any normal person.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Red|Kilton}} at {{Color BotW|Red|Fang and Bone}} is way more interested in researching monsters than any normal person should be.|Chabi|BotW}} After Link has visited the Fang and Bone for the first time, Chabi notes that Kilton has been spotted all over Hyrule Kingdom, not just in Akkala.{{Cite|He's been sighted all over the place now, not just Akkala. Should I be worried?|Chabi|BotW}} She shares stories of his shop popping up out of nowhere when night falls.{{Cite|The creepiest part of the stories is how he's supposed to pop up out of nowhere once night falls.|Chabi|BotW}}{{Cite|Apparently, he shows up after dark where you least expect him. It could be anywhere in the world.|Chabi|BotW}} Because of this, she is beginning to doubt whether she wants to meet him.{{Cite|I'm not as sure as I used to be that I actually want to meet him...|Chabi|BotW}} When Link saves Chabi again, she might insist that she did not need his help.{{Cite|OK, I admit you helped. I didn't need it, so don't expect any thanks, but you can have this if you want.|Chabi|BotW}} However, she might thank him for making the situation simpler.{{Cite|Well, you sure made that simpler than it would've been otherwise. I should do something to thank you, I suppose.|Chabi|BotW}} She is embarrassed she had to have Link save her again.{{Cite|I'm so embarrassed you had to rescue my AGAIN. Ugh. Anyway...|Chabi|BotW}} Though she has not gotten anywhere in her search for Kilton, she has not given up.{{Cite|I haven't given up the search for the Kilton guy and his {{Color BotW|Red|Fang and Bone}}, but I haven't gotten anywhere yet either.|Chabi|BotW}} She swears to find him someday.{{Cite|But mark my words...I'll find him someday!|Chabi|BotW}} Chabi camps at the following locations: * The fork in the road on the [[West Hyrule Plains]] near [[Ludfo's Bog]]. Here, she is attacked by a [[Blue Bokoblin]]. * The ruins of a house south of [[Serenne Stable]] on [[Rowan Plain]]. She is found fighting a [[Black Bokoblin]]. * The road east of the [[Akkala Parade Ground Ruins]], where she fights a Blue Bokoblin. * In the [[Shadow Pass]] forest south of the [[Shadow Hamlet Ruins]]. She is attacked by a Blue Bokoblin at this location. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Trivia== * Chabi is one of several characters in {{BotW|-}} that will hit [[Link]] back if he attacks them with a [[Weapon]].{{Cite|Bring it on!|Chabi|BotW}}{{Cite|You looking to fight?!|Chabi|BotW}}{{Cite|What are you doing?!|Chabi|BotW}} These attacks deal no damage. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fang and Bone * Hylian * Strongest in the World }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hylians, Hyruleans |characters= BotW, TotK }}
